definition: to drink until alcohol affects you
description: A young woman with long messy black hair, a sparkly black top and a paper party hat stands on a leather sofa in a small karaoke room with coloured disco lights on the walls. With her eyes shut she sings loudly into a microphone and throws out one arm, then drops down onto the sofa, still singing and laughing. Two young women beside her laugh and cover their ears, one holding her leg. On the low table lie a half-empty beer bottle, several glasses, one knocked over, spilled crisps and a tambourine, and a TV screen glows on the wall.
